title: Su Ballu Tundu - Video tutorial ballo sardo | Ballamus nois ca sos ballos sunt sos nostros

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the cultural context and movements of the traditional dance while demonstrating steps with two dancers. He breaks down the male and female footwork clearly using verbal descriptions and visual splits on screen.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the video tutorial on Su Ballu Tundu
Explanation of the circle formation rotating clockwise
Overview of the two main phases: Sa Seria and S'Allegrada
Detailed breakdown of male footwork for Sa Seria and S'Allegrada
Detailed breakdown of female footwork for Sa Seria and S'Allegrada
Full demonstration of the dance by the two dancers

metaphors: I bravi ballerini ballassero con un bicchiere sulla testa

steps_taught.name: Sa Seria
steps_taught.description: A serious step starting on the right foot followed by alternating steps.

steps_taught.name: S'Allegrada
steps_taught.description: A joyful, more playful phase involving lighter jumping or bouncing movements.

what_works: Split screens showing both upper body posture and footwork close-ups simultaneously
Clear division between male and female variations
what_hinders: Lack of slow practice counts with audio

quotes.text: Ballamus nois ca sos ballos sunt sos nostros
Una parte più seria chiamata appunto a passu o a sa seria
Una parte allegrada, brincalada dove si deve saltellare

evidence_segments.observation: Close-up of feet stepping side by side in traditional shoes.
Split screen showing overall dancer posture on the left and footwork close-up on the right.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a synchronized split-screen format that pairs an upper-body view of the instructor or dancers with a footwork close-up throughout the instructional sections.
